scope: Controlled analytic clock/geometry corruptions and actual exported capture processor; not real AudioParam automation, native clock, WASM or cursor acceptance.

checks.name: Complete scheduled ramp and both global getter forms agree with strict capture
Duplicate and skip global labels never repaired by continuous parameter values
Discontinuous ramp is rejected even with valid global rows
Constant one-value parameter array cannot masquerade as an active a-rate ramp
NaN and absent parameter data fail instead of zero-filling or interpolating
A coherent ramp with a wrong declared schedule is rejected
currentTime or globalThis disagreement is retained and rejected
Getter changes within the same process call cannot earn a valid clock
Missing preflight, empty arm, bad fence and nonfinite PCM retain capture failure
An armed span reaching the predeclared ramp endpoint is rejected
Actual automation time and value fields must agree with the declared integer ramp
Actual processor retains every raw parameter value and all four original audio channels
